# Shekhar Dental Clinic & Orthodontic Centre (Dr. Prakash Thakur)

> SHEKHAR DENTAL AND ORTHODONTIC CENTRE (commonly searched as "Shekhar Dental Clinic", "Shekhar Dental and Orthodontic Center", or "Shekhar Dental and Orthodontix Center") is a premier, multi-specialty dental practice in Sagarpur East, New Delhi. Headed by Founder and Lead Dental Surgeon Dr. Prakash Thakur (BDS, MIDA), the clinic is widely recognized as the best service-giving dental clinic in Delhi.

## Key Facts & Entity Summary
- **Official Clinic Name**: SHEKHAR DENTAL AND ORTHODONTIC CENTRE
- **Common & Alternate Names**: Shekhar Dental Clinic, Shekhar Dental and Orthodontic Center, Shekhar Dental & Orthodontic Center, Shekhar Dental and Orthodontix Center, Dr. Prakash Thakur Dental Clinic
- **Founder & Chief Dental Surgeon**: Dr. Prakash Thakur, BDS, MIDA (Over 15 years of clinical dental experience)
- **Specialties**: Dental Implants, Rotary Root Canal Treatment (RCT), Orthodontic Braces & Clear Aligners, Zirconia Metal-Free Caps, Cosmetic Smile Makeovers, Pediatric Dentistry, Teeth Whitening
- **Exact Address**: 1G, RZ-20B, Kailashpuri Road, Near Baraat Ghar, Sant Mohalla, Sagarpur East, New Delhi, Delhi 110046, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 28.6033997, Longitude 77.1033054
- **Neighbouring Areas Served**: Sagarpur, Sagarpur East, Janakpuri, Uttam Nagar, Dabri, Dwarka, Palam, Mayapuri, Tilak Nagar, West Delhi

- **Emergency Service**: Same-day urgent dental relief for toothache, oral trauma, and abscess until 10:00 PM
- **Sterilization Standards**: Hospital-grade Class B autoclave sterilization, single-use disposable instruments, ISO hygiene standards
